message:
I remember the time my daughter asked me if I really needed to keep a go-bag in the car. I chuckled as I pulled out my carefully organized backpack, filled with water, snacks, and even a little first-aid kit. "What if we get stuck somewhere?" I said, trying to sound wise while she rolled her eyes. 

While some might call me gloriously over-prepared, I see it as a little peace of mind. After all, it's not just about the stuff in the bag, but knowing we’re ready for whatever little surprises life throws at us. 

Isn’t it nice to be prepared, even if it seems a bit much sometimes?
